name: Barbell Bench Press
instructions: Lie on a flat bench, grip the bar slightly wider than shoulder width, lower it to mid-chest under control, then press back to lockout.

name: Incline Barbell Bench Press
instructions: On a bench set to 30-45 degrees, lower the bar to the upper chest and press it back up over the shoulders.

name: Decline Barbell Bench Press
instructions: With feet secured on a decline bench, lower the bar to the lower chest and press it back to lockout.

name: Dumbbell Bench Press
instructions: Lie flat holding a dumbbell over each shoulder, lower them to chest level with elbows at about 45 degrees, then press up.

name: Incline Dumbbell Press
instructions: On an incline bench, lower the dumbbells to the sides of the upper chest and press them back together overhead.

name: Dumbbell Fly
instructions: Lying flat with a slight bend in the elbows, open the arms in a wide arc until you feel a chest stretch, then bring the dumbbells back together.

name: Cable Crossover
instructions: Standing between two high pulleys, sweep the handles down and together in front of the hips, then return slowly.

name: Machine Chest Press
instructions: Set the seat so the handles line up with mid-chest, press forward to near lockout, and return under control.

name: Pec Deck
instructions: Sit tall with arms on the pads or handles and bring them together in front of the chest, then open slowly.

name: Push-Up
instructions: From a straight-arm plank, lower the chest to just above the floor keeping the body in one line, then press back up.

name: Chest Dip
instructions: On parallel bars, lean the torso forward and lower until the shoulders are just below the elbows, then press back up.

name: Deadlift
instructions: With the bar over mid-foot, hinge down and grip it, brace, and stand up by driving through the floor, keeping the bar close. Lower it the same way.

name: Sumo Deadlift
instructions: Take a wide stance with toes turned out, grip inside the knees, and stand up by pushing the knees out and the hips forward.

name: Romanian Deadlift
instructions: From standing, push the hips back with a soft knee bend and lower the bar along the legs until the hamstrings are stretched, then drive the hips forward.

name: Trap Bar Deadlift
instructions: Stand inside the trap bar, grip the handles, brace, and stand up tall, then lower under control.

name: Rack Pull
instructions: Set the bar on pins at about knee height and pull it to lockout, squeezing the glutes and upper back at the top.

name: Barbell Row
instructions: Hinge forward with a flat back and row the bar to the lower ribs, then lower it until the arms are straight.

name: Pendlay Row
instructions: With the torso near parallel to the floor, row the bar explosively from a dead stop on the floor to the lower chest, and return it to the floor each rep.

name: Dumbbell Row
instructions: With one hand and knee on a bench, row the dumbbell toward the hip, then lower it to a full stretch.

name: T-Bar Row
instructions: Straddle the bar, hinge forward, and row the handle to the chest, keeping the back flat.

name: Seated Cable Row
instructions: Sitting tall with a slight knee bend, pull the handle to the stomach while squeezing the shoulder blades together, then extend the arms.

name: Lat Pulldown
instructions: Grip the bar wider than the shoulders and pull it to the upper chest while leaning back slightly, then let it rise under control.

name: Close-Grip Lat Pulldown
instructions: Using a close neutral-grip handle, pull to the upper chest keeping the elbows close to the body.

name: Pull-Up
instructions: Hang from the bar with an overhand grip and pull until the chin clears the bar, then lower to a full hang.

name: Chin-Up
instructions: Hang with an underhand, shoulder-width grip and pull the chin over the bar, then lower fully.

name: Inverted Row
instructions: Hanging under a bar with heels on the floor and body straight, pull the chest to the bar and lower.

name: Straight-Arm Pulldown
instructions: With arms nearly straight, sweep the bar from eye level down to the thighs using the lats, then return slowly.

name: Face Pull
instructions: With a rope at face height, pull toward the forehead while flaring the elbows and rotating the hands back.

name: Back Extension
instructions: On a hyperextension bench, lower the torso by hinging at the hips, then raise it back to a straight line.

name: Barbell Shrug
instructions: Holding the bar at arm's length, lift the shoulders straight up toward the ears, pause, and lower.

name: Dumbbell Shrug
instructions: With a dumbbell in each hand at your sides, shrug the shoulders straight up, pause, and lower.

name: Overhead Press
instructions: Standing with the bar at the collarbone, brace and press it overhead to lockout, moving the head back and then through.

name: Seated Dumbbell Shoulder Press
instructions: Seated with back support, press the dumbbells from shoulder height to overhead, then lower.

name: Arnold Press
instructions: Start with palms facing you at the chin and rotate them outward while pressing overhead; reverse on the way down.

name: Machine Shoulder Press
instructions: Adjust the seat so the handles start at shoulder height and press overhead, then return under control.

name: Dumbbell Lateral Raise
instructions: With a slight elbow bend, raise the dumbbells out to the sides until they reach shoulder height, then lower slowly.

name: Cable Lateral Raise
instructions: Standing side-on to a low pulley, raise the handle out to shoulder height with the far arm, then lower slowly.

name: Dumbbell Front Raise
instructions: Raise the dumbbells straight in front to shoulder height, then lower them under control.

name: Rear Delt Fly
instructions: Hinged forward with a flat back, raise the dumbbells out to the sides leading with the elbows, then lower.

name: Upright Row
instructions: Holding the bar with a shoulder-width grip, pull it up along the body to chest height with elbows high, then lower.

name: Band Pull-Apart
instructions: Hold a band at shoulder height with straight arms and pull it apart until it touches the chest, then return slowly.

name: Barbell Curl
instructions: Standing with elbows at your sides, curl the bar to the shoulders without swinging, then lower fully.

name: Dumbbell Curl
instructions: Curl the dumbbells up while turning the palms to face the shoulders, then lower under control.

name: Hammer Curl
instructions: With palms facing each other, curl the dumbbells to the shoulders and lower slowly.

name: EZ-Bar Preacher Curl
instructions: With the upper arms on the preacher pad, curl the bar up and lower it to nearly straight arms.

name: Cable Curl
instructions: Facing a low pulley, curl the bar to the shoulders keeping the elbows fixed, then lower.

name: Incline Dumbbell Curl
instructions: Seated on an incline bench with arms hanging behind the torso, curl the dumbbells up and lower to a full stretch.

name: Concentration Curl
instructions: Seated with the elbow braced against the inner thigh, curl the dumbbell to the shoulder and lower slowly.

name: Tricep Pushdown
instructions: With elbows pinned at your sides, push the bar or rope down until the arms are straight, then let it rise to about 90 degrees.

name: Overhead Tricep Extension
instructions: Holding one dumbbell overhead with both hands, lower it behind the head by bending the elbows, then extend.

name: Skull Crusher
instructions: Lying flat, lower the bar toward the forehead by bending only at the elbows, then extend back up.

name: Close-Grip Bench Press
instructions: Bench press with hands about shoulder-width apart and elbows tucked, touching the lower chest.

name: Bench Dip
instructions: With hands on a bench behind you and legs extended, lower the hips by bending the elbows, then press back up.

name: Wrist Curl
instructions: Forearms resting on the thighs with palms up, curl the weight up using only the wrists, then lower.

name: Back Squat
instructions: With the bar on the upper back, brace and sit down between the hips to at least parallel, then drive back up.

name: Front Squat
instructions: With the bar across the front of the shoulders and elbows high, squat down keeping the torso upright, then stand.

name: Goblet Squat
instructions: Holding a kettlebell at the chest, squat down between the knees keeping the chest up, then stand.

name: Leg Press
instructions: With feet shoulder-width on the platform, lower it until the knees reach about 90 degrees, then press without locking the knees.

name: Hack Squat
instructions: With shoulders under the pads, squat down to at least parallel and drive back up through the whole foot.

name: Bulgarian Split Squat
instructions: With the rear foot on a bench, lower until the front thigh is about parallel, then drive up through the front foot.

name: Walking Lunge
instructions: Step forward and lower the back knee toward the floor, then drive through the front foot into the next step.

name: Step-Up
instructions: Step onto a box with one foot and stand up fully using that leg, then step back down.

name: Leg Extension
instructions: Seated with the pad above the ankles, extend the knees until the legs are straight, then lower slowly.

name: Lying Leg Curl
instructions: Lying face down with the pad behind the ankles, curl the heels toward the glutes, then lower slowly.

name: Seated Leg Curl
instructions: Seated with the pad behind the lower legs, curl the heels under the seat, then return under control.

name: Barbell Hip Thrust
instructions: With the upper back on a bench and the bar over the hips, drive the hips up until the torso is level, squeeze, and lower.

name: Glute Bridge
instructions: Lying on your back with knees bent, drive the hips up until knees, hips and shoulders line up, then lower.

name: Bodyweight Squat
instructions: Squat down with the chest up until the thighs are at least parallel, then stand back up.

name: Standing Calf Raise
instructions: With the balls of the feet on the edge, rise as high as possible onto the toes, pause, then lower to a full stretch.

name: Seated Calf Raise
instructions: Seated with the pad on the knees, raise the heels as high as possible, then lower to a full stretch.

name: Hip Adduction Machine
instructions: Seated with the pads inside the knees, squeeze the legs together, then open under control.

name: Hip Abduction Machine
instructions: Seated with the pads outside the knees, push the legs apart, then return slowly.

name: Kettlebell Swing
instructions: Hike the kettlebell back between the legs, then snap the hips forward to swing it to chest height, letting it fall back into the next rep.

name: Plank
instructions: Hold a straight line from head to heels on the forearms and toes, bracing the abs. Log the hold as a duration.

name: Side Plank
instructions: On one forearm with feet stacked, lift the hips into a straight line and hold. Log the hold as a duration.

name: Crunch
instructions: Lying on your back with knees bent, curl the shoulders off the floor toward the pelvis, then lower.

name: Hanging Leg Raise
instructions: Hanging from a bar, raise the legs to at least hip height without swinging, then lower slowly.

name: Cable Crunch
instructions: Kneeling below a high pulley with the rope at your head, crunch the ribs toward the hips, then return.

name: Ab Wheel Rollout
instructions: Kneeling with the wheel under the shoulders, roll forward as far as you can control with a flat back, then pull back.

name: Russian Twist
instructions: Seated leaning back with feet up, rotate the torso side to side. Each side counts as one rep.

name: Treadmill Run
instructions: Log the run as a duration and/or distance.

name: Outdoor Run
instructions: Log the run as a duration and/or distance.

name: Stationary Bike
instructions: Log the ride as a duration and/or distance.

name: Rowing Machine
instructions: Drive with the legs, then lean back and pull the handle to the ribs. Log as a duration and/or distance.

name: Elliptical
instructions: Log the session as a duration and/or distance.

name: Stair Climber
instructions: Log the climb as a duration.

name: Jump Rope
instructions: Log as a duration, or as reps for a counted set.

name: Burpee
instructions: Drop into a squat, kick back to a plank, return to the squat, and jump up. One full cycle is one rep.

name: World's Greatest Stretch
instructions: From a deep lunge, drop the inside elbow toward the front foot, then rotate that arm to the ceiling. Log each side as reps.

name: Hip 90/90
instructions: Seated with both knees bent at 90 degrees, rotate the legs from side to side keeping the chest tall.

name: Cat-Cow
instructions: On hands and knees, alternate between rounding the spine up and letting it sag down, moving with the breath.
